About this Dashboard:


Measures that demonstrate the historic growth and future growth potential of the business along with the quality of revenues. These figures can be used to show the trajectory and potential of the business.


Gross Margin Contribution

The amount of historic and forecast gross margin contribution (in absolute monetary terms) for each service line. The underlying report tells you which Business Units and service lines are contributing to the company revenues and margins and also shows the trending growth/decline. 


Gross Margin Quality

The amount of historic and forecast revenue gross margin percent for each service line. This tells you the quality of the revenue and likely premium service lines (or Business Units on drill down) and also shows the trending growth/decline. 


Engagement Backlog

The total amount of contracted (won) work, where the revenue has yet to be earned.


Engagement Backlog by Month

The amount of contracted (won) work, where the revenue has yet to be earned. The underlying report shows the amount of revenue that will be earned by month, by Business Unit/service line.


The backlog amount and timeline by which it is earned shows the revenue from the sold business, even if no more is sold. This is a good health proxy, and ideally this figure continually grows over time. 


Book to Bill Ratio

Over the current calendar year, this chart shows the ratio between the amount of new business sold (bookings) versus the revenue earned in the same period.


The book-to-bill ratio indicates whether the business is ‘growing’ or ‘shrinking’. A services business should be selling more (bookings) than it is earning revenue, to be sure it is ultimately growing.
